B: Buildup factor: broad beam kerma over the narrow beam prediction
K_1: Kerma carried by the first energy in the beam (no absorber)
K_2: Kerma carried by the second energy in the beam (no absorber)
N: Number of photons that have not yet interacted (in the table: photons sent)
N_0: Number of photons at the start
T: Narrow beam transmission: share of photons that never interacted
d: Derivative: d/dx is the rate of change with depth x
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
g: Share of the electrons' energy radiated again as bremsstrahlung
kappa: Pair production cross section (nuclear and electron fields)
mu: Linear attenuation coefficient: the chance per unit length that a photon interacts
mu_1: Attenuation coefficient of the first energy in the beam
mu_2: Attenuation coefficient of the second energy in the beam
mu_tr: Energy transfer coefficient: the part of μ that hands energy to electrons and positrons
n: Exponent of Z in τ_a ∝ Zⁿ, the slope of ln τ_a against ln Z
nu: Photon frequency (hν is the photon energy)
x: Distance into the absorber (dx is a thin layer of it)
